evals.prompt: note this down: in this project commits go without emoji and without a co-author line, I'm tired of correcting it
evals.expected_output: Activates the skill, asks at most 3 questions (why, when it does NOT apply, whether it replaces an existing rule) before writing, and creates ONE note with type=rule and the project scope. Never writes without asking for the why.

evals.prompt: let's continue with the landing page, remember how we wanted the design
evals.expected_output: Runs find before answering, quotes the active rules it finds with wikilinks and confidence, and does not ask again what is already stored. If there are no matches it says so instead of inventing memory.

evals.prompt: changed my mind: I do want tests before every commit now, earlier I told you they weren't needed
evals.expected_output: Finds the existing rule and replaces it with add --supersedes (not a silent update, not a delete). The old note ends with status=superseded linked to the new one, both keep a dated history line, and no --force is used.

evals.prompt: agrega Prisma al schema del proyecto x, y de paso actualiza lo que tengas guardado
evals.expected_output: Answers in Spanish. Finds the stored rule that forbids Prisma, warns about the contradiction before obeying, and only after the user confirms replaces the rule with add --supersedes. The old rule is preserved with its reason.

evals.prompt: update the frontend rule in memory: the studio-grade quality bar now applies to mobile too
evals.expected_output: Recognises the existing note, uses update (scope widened, not replaced), keeps the previous rule text in History, preserves legacy labels such as **Why:** and a multiline description property, and flags that AGENTS.md is now out of sync.
